text: Sinno Men Jaabino ɓe, Men Jippinani ɓe Malaa'ika, ɓe yi'i ɓen, maayɓe ɓen kadi yeewtidi e maɓɓe, ɓen humpita ɓe ko goonga adduɗaa, Men Mooɓani ɓe kadi kala huunde nde ɓe lamndii ; ɓe laatotanooko gomɗinooɓe kon ko adduɗaa, si wanaa nde Alla Muuyani ɓe peewal. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe hino majjaa ɗum, ɓe fewtataa ka Alla, haa O no O hawriɓe e peewal.
